To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the location decisions of business firms are driven by internal and external factors, and that (2) these decisions should be accommodated, as far as possible and feasible, by spatial planning.

the business sector is an important factor in spatial planning, that the spatial planning sector is an important actor in regional economic development and that the interaction between these sectors can be enhanced by the use of a new spatial planning concept.

the spatial development of a region depends on a number of factors, such as the location of firms, the location of households, the location of public services and infrastructure and the location of nature and recreation.
